b2plus-lazim-ma.title: Mustn't/Shouldn't: Lazim Ma
b2plus-lazim-ma.explanation: To say someone shouldn't do something, ما slots in right before the verb, after لازم stays in place: لازم ما بتشوف هلق (lazim ma btshuf hala2, "you shouldn't see it now"). لازم itself never takes ما directly -- the negation always attaches to the verb that follows it.
b2plus-lazim-ma.fact: This exact pattern -- a fixed modal word followed by ما plus a verb -- is one of the most common ways Syrian Arabic gives advice or warnings, similar to how English speakers lean on "shouldn't" far more often than a flat "don't."

items.ar: لازم ما باخد السيف اليوم لأن غالي كتير
items.en: I shouldn't take the sword today because it's very expensive
items.translit: lazim ma bexud es-seif el-yom la2an ghali ktir

items.ar: لازم ما بياخد صديقه السيف اليوم لأن عندن واحد
items.en: His friend shouldn't take the sword today because they have one
items.translit: lazim ma byexud sadee2o es-seif el-yom la2an 3andun wahed

items.ar: لازم ما بتاخدي الورد اليوم، عندك ورد كتير
items.en: You shouldn't take the flowers today, you have a lot of flowers
items.translit: lazim ma btexdi el-ward el-yom, 3andek ward ktir

items.ar: لازم ما مناخد الزيت اليوم لأن عندنا كتير
items.en: We shouldn't take the oil today because we have a lot
items.translit: lazim ma mnexud ez-zeit el-yom la2an 3andna ktir

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Come to the Bank

items.ar: لازم ما بجي البنك اليوم لأن عندي مصاري كتير
items.en: I shouldn't come to the bank today because I have a lot of money
items.translit: lazim ma biji el-bank el-yom la2an 3andi masaari ktir

items.ar: لازم ما بيجي ابنه البنك اليوم لأن تعبان كتير
items.en: His son shouldn't come to the bank today because he's very tired
items.translit: lazim ma byiji ibno el-bank el-yom la2an ta3ban ktir

items.ar: لازم ما بتجي المدينة اليوم لأن عندك شغلة كبيرة
items.en: You shouldn't come to the city today because you have a big matter
items.translit: lazim ma btiji el-madiine el-yom la2an 3andek shaghle kbeere

items.ar: لازم ما منجي هون اليوم لأن تعبانين كتير من الشغلة
items.en: We shouldn't come here today because we're very tired from the matter
items.translit: lazim ma mniji hown el-yom la2an ta3banin ktir min esh-shaghle

items.ar: لازم ما بخلص المصاري اليوم لأن عندي شغلة بكرة
items.en: I shouldn't finish the money today because I have a matter tomorrow
items.translit: lazim ma bxalliş el-masaari el-yom la2an 3andi shaghle bukra

items.ar: لازم ما بيخلص صديقه المصاري اليوم لأن فقير كتير
items.en: His friend shouldn't finish the money today because he's very poor
items.translit: lazim ma byixlaş sadee2o el-masaari el-yom la2an faqiir ktir

items.ar: لازم ما بتخلصي مصاريك اليوم لأن عندك بيت غالي
items.en: You shouldn't finish your money today because you have an expensive house
items.translit: lazim ma btixlaşi masaariki el-yom la2an 3andek beit ghali

items.ar: لازم ما منخلص مصارينا اليوم، منيح كتير والحمدلله
items.en: We shouldn't finish our money today, very good, thank God
items.translit: lazim ma mnixlaş masaarina el-yom, mnih ktir wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: صديقي الغني عنده قط منيح كتير اليوم، والحمدلله
items.en: My rich friend has a very good cat today, thank God
items.translit: sadee2i el-ghani 3ando 2it mnih ktir el-yom, wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: لازم ما بيحب القط الغالي اليوم، بيحب القط الرخيص
items.en: He shouldn't love the expensive cat today, he loves the cheap cat
items.translit: lazim ma byhib el-2it el-ghali el-yom, byhib el-2it er-rkhees

items.ar: مدري وين قط صديقي هلق، بس بيحبه كتير والحمدلله
items.en: I don't know where my friend's cat is now, but he loves it a lot, thank God
items.translit: midri wein 2it sadee2i hala2, bas byhibbo ktir wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: لازم ما منحب قط الفقير الغالي اليوم، منحب قط الرخيص
items.en: We shouldn't love the poor person's expensive cat today, we love the cheap cat
items.translit: lazim ma mnhib 2it el-faqiir el-ghali el-yom, mnhib 2it er-rkhees

items.ar: هاد صديقي المسيحي اليوم، منيح كتير والحمدلله
items.en: This is my Christian friend today, very good, thank God
items.translit: haad sadee2i el-masiiHi el-yom, mnih ktir wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: لازم ما بيحب صديقه المسيحي الغالي، بيحب صديقه الرخيص
items.en: He shouldn't love his expensive Christian friend, he loves his cheap friend
items.translit: lazim ma byhib sadee2o el-masiiHi el-ghali, byhib sadee2o er-rkhees

items.ar: مدري وين صديقي المسيحي هلق، بس عنده بيت قريب من البحر
items.en: I don't know where my Christian friend is now, but he has a house near the sea
items.translit: midri wein sadee2i el-masiiHi hala2, bas 3ando beit 2areeb min el-ba7er

items.ar: لازم ما منشوف صديقنا المسيحي هلق لأن عنده شغلة كبيرة
items.en: We shouldn't see our Christian friend now because he has a big matter
items.translit: lazim ma mnshuf sadee2na el-masiiHi hala2 la2an 3ando shaghle kbeere
